what: Each of the 402 test files (tests/test_*.py) of Graphify 0.9.88 (commit a9860f70): whether the graph engine's comparison checks run it against the engine, and if not, why. A file is run when at least one of its tests runs and passes in a check, or when the engine fails one of its tests (a known difference). 'checks' names the checks that run it (crates/graphicle-graph/tools/); 'tests_passed' counts its test items that passed in the 14 October run; 'known_differences' lists the tests the engine fails, with the reason; 'tests_not_run' lists the tests of a newly run file that its check leaves out, with the reason.

runs.2026-10-13: engine-parity-0.9.88.json: the 96 checks on macOS (arm64), all passed
runs.2026-10-14: the widened checks on Linux (x86_64), source set 85f2d451, with every upstream test item's outcome recorded; README.md in this folder says how the run was made
